symbols.name: integers
symbols.meaning: The set of integers, whose elements are the whole numbers, which may be negative.
symbols.quote: Here $\mathbb{Z}$ is the set of integers.

relations.quote: A grid numerator is the numerator of a [Gaussian dyadic](gaussian-dyadics.md) with denominator $2^p$
These integers are worked on by the error analysis and the [carry propagation](carry-propagation.md) that follow.
